finding: Supabase CLI migration-list table cells can contain presentation backticks; matching raw cells against /^\d{14}$/ can silently discard valid migration rows and produce false empty drift.
rule: Provider CLI table output must be normalized before machine identity comparison; presentation delimiters are not part of migration identity.
prevention: normalize backticks and whitespace before migration version validation
apply identical normalization to pre-repair and post-repair parity parsers
root_cause: Supabase CLI renders migration-list version cells with presentation backticks; the trusted repair parser validated raw cells against a bare 14-digit regex, discarded the four expected local-only versions, and failed closed with a false empty drift before any production mutation.
evidence: trusted-main run 37354534547 reached production through GitHub OIDC and stopped before mutation with UNEXPECTED_PRE_REPAIR_DRIFT:[] while the CLI table visibly contained all four expected local-only versions
both pre-repair and post-repair parsers now normalize surrounding backticks before identity comparison
